items.title: Doug Carn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2023
items.q: follow Mike Brecker around you know

ctx.x: Do you think that jazz education sort of the explosion of it in the last twenty years has been a good thing for the music?

Well in a way, see the music is very broad and there have been aspects to it you know. And one aspect that’s been making it accessible to musicians who ordinarily wouldn’t access it you know. And on the other hand it’s big in that kind of mundane and dry to people who loved it enough to run away from home and move to New York and sleep on the floor in an apartment in the Village and hang out until two or three in the morning and follow Kenny Garrett around, you know, and follow Mike Brecker around you know,…
